title: A parent can run at most 4 delegations at once, so a 3-pair family-split review round can't start all 6 reviewers
outcome: A parent session can run the six read-only reviewers that a three-family review round needs, or the host tells it plainly how many it can run and when the next slot frees, without unsafe load on the host.
acceptance: A parent can hold six concurrent read-only reviewer delegations, or the per-parent limit is set from a stated resource reason and the refusal says the limit and how to proceed.
A behaviour test covers the limit boundary and the refusal text; existing limits for other delegation kinds are unchanged unless deliberately changed and stated.

completion.summary: Landed the six-total read-only Reviewer admission limit and safe count/limit/retry guidance through backend and UI. Other delegation kinds retain four; shared counting and both admission checks are preserved.
